# Tribal College Journal

> > A comprehensive news and information platform dedicated to tribal colleges and universities, featuring journalism, resources, and community engagement for Native American higher education.

Tribal College Journal serves as the primary news source and resource hub for the tribal college movement, covering education initiatives, institutional achievements, and opportunities across the American Indian higher education landscape. The platform combines editorial content with practical tools like job boards, college directories, and archival resources.

## Key Topics

- Tribal colleges and universities
- Native American education
- Indigenous higher education
- Teacher education
- Language revitalization
- American Indian College Fund
- AIHEC (American Indian Higher Education Consortium)
- Tribal college journalism
- Decolonization in education
- Culturally responsive teaching
- Tribal energy leadership
- Student writing and creativity
- Tribal sovereignty
- Indian Country news
- Academic publication

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [Tribal College Journal Homepage](https://tribalcollegejournal.org): Main hub for news, features, and resources from tribal colleges and universities.
- [Tribal Colleges Map & Directory](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/tribal-colleges): Interactive map and comprehensive directory of tribal colleges with degree programs and enrollment data across the U.S. and Canada.
- [Explore TCJ Archives](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/explore-tcj): Search and browse Tribal College Journal issues by year and keyword for historical content and research.

## Subscriptions & Advertising

- [Subscribe to Tribal College Journal](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/subscribe): Magazine subscription form with flexible payment options for educators and students.
- [Advertising Opportunities](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/advertiser-information): Print, web, and email advertising options and media kit for reaching tribal college educators and Native American higher education audiences.

## Opportunities & Community

- [Tribal College Journal Job Board](https://jobs.tribalcollegejournal.org/jobs): Career opportunities in tribal education, language revitalization, indigenous leadership, and related fields.
- [Support Tribal College Journal](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/donate): Make a donation to support the mission of covering and advancing tribal higher education.
- [2026 Reader Survey](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/survey2026): Community feedback survey to help shape future content and coverage.

## Teacher Education & Decolonization

- [From Conformity to Creativity: Preparing Teachers to Foster Native Student Success](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/from-conformity-to-creativity-preparing-teachers-to-foster-native-student-success): Feature on Diné College's innovative teacher education program aligned with Navajo Nation decolonization principles.
- [Rooted in Community: Stories of Transformation Through Teacher Education](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/college-of-menominee-nation-stories-of-transformation-through-teacher-education): Profile of College of Menominee Nation's culturally responsive teacher education model and student success stories.

## Institutional News & Recognition

- [College Fund Names Leander "Russ" McDonald TCU President Honoree of the Year](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/leander-russ-mcdonald-named-tribal-college-president-honoree-of-the-year): Recognition of Dr. Leander McDonald by the American Indian College Fund for tribal college leadership.
- [Achieving the Dream Honors IAIA as a Leader College](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/achieving-the-dream-honors-iaia-as-a-leader-college): Institute of American Indian Arts recognized as a Leader College by Achieving the Dream organization.
- [Cynthia Lindquist Joins College Fund as Chief Strategy Officer](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/cynthia-lindquist-joins-college-fund-as-chief-strategy-officer): Announcement of Dr. Cynthia Lindquist's leadership appointment at the American Indian College Fund.
- [Haskell Announces Tribal Energy Leaders Fellowship](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/haskell-indian-nation-announces-tribal-energy-leaders-fellowship): New fellowship program at Haskell for developing clean energy and tribal sovereignty leaders.

## Research, Grants & Student Opportunities

- [Blackfeet Community College Instructor Receives Grant to Study Long-COVID](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/blackfeet-community-college-instructor-receives-grant-to-study-long-covid): Research grant awarded to Blackfeet Community College faculty for long-COVID investigation.
- [American Indian College Fund Receives Award for Adult Education Program](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/american-indian-college-fund-receives-award-for-adult-education-program): Grant recognition for American Indian College Fund's adult education and workforce reentry initiatives.
- [Summer Law Program Open to Tribal College Students](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/summer-law-program-open-to-tribal-college-students): Pre-Law Summer Institute announcement for tribal college students interested in legal careers.
- [Theodore Van Alst Jr. and Shane Hawk Announce TCJ Student Writing Winners](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/theodore-van-alst-jr-and-shane-hawk-announce-tcj-student-writing-winners): Winners announced for Tribal College Journal Student Writing Contest in creative writing categories.

## Optional: Roundup & Spotlight

- [Saving a Language: UTTC Students Study Hidatsa Language](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/roundup/saving-a-language-uttc-students-study-hidatsa-language): Roundup on United Tribes Technical College students engaged in Hidatsa language revitalization work.
- [Haskell Students Draw the News](https://tribalcollegejournal.org/roundup/haskell-students-draw-the-news): Roundup feature on Haskell students' news illustration and visual journalism project.
